'''2014 US Nationals Day 1 Mike D'Ambrosio LS Restore Freedom To The Galaxy''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike D'Ambrosio]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7)|Restore Freedom To The Galaxy]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
